cards.note: Episode 3 describes internal-range liquidity and market-structure shifts. Its chapter at 2:08 is a starting point for source review; no lecture transcript was obtained.
Existing close-through-confirmed-pivot events are measurable research proxies. Their BOS/CHoCH labels have not been validated as equivalent to ICT market-structure shifts.
The existing detector measures a trade-through and close-back across an already confirmed pivot. It does not observe actual resting stops or prove a reversal.
The existing three-candle non-overlap zone is available only after candle three closes. Its ATR filter and gap-fill rules are code conventions requiring annotation and ablation studies.
Define session boundaries with explicit timezone and historical DST evidence. Keep event publication times and revisions point-in-time. No universal ICT session window is certified here.
The selected personal ceiling is 0.5% of original account size and at most three entries daily, including zero. Existing risk gates can reduce this ceiling. Account binding is not implemented.

Fit only after dataset eligibility is established. Separate chronological training, calibration and untouched evaluation; purge overlapping labels. Include costs, no-trade cases and failed setups. Video study is not evidence of market accuracy.
